name.zh: 40 号联邦公路（跨洋公路，Carretera Interoceánica）

aka.zh: 马萨特兰—马塔莫罗斯公路
魔鬼脊公路（杜兰戈—马萨特兰段）

tagline.en: Across northern Mexico from the Pacific at Mazatlán to the border at Reynosa, by Durango, Torreón, Saltillo and Monterrey, over the Sierra Madre on the Espinazo del Diablo
tagline.zh: 从太平洋岸的马萨特兰横穿墨西哥北部到边境的雷诺萨，途经杜兰戈、托雷翁、萨尔蒂约和蒙特雷，在魔鬼脊翻越马德雷山

start.en: Villa Unión, Sinaloa, at the junction with Federal Highway 15 south of Mazatlán
start.zh: 锡那罗亚州比利亚乌尼翁，马萨特兰以南与 15 号联邦公路交会处

end.en: Reynosa, Tamaulipas, on the border with Texas
end.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州雷诺萨，与得克萨斯州接壤的边境

en: Federal Highway 40 climbs from the Sinaloa coast at Villa Unión into the Sierra Madre Occidental, crosses it by the Espinazo del Diablo to the city of Durango, and runs across the plateau to the Laguna region at Gómez Palacio and Torreón. From there it crosses the Coahuila desert to Saltillo, drops to Monterrey, and runs down the plain by Cadereyta to Reynosa on the Rio Grande. Spanish Wikipedia calls it the Carretera Interoceánica, or the Mazatlán–Matamoros road, after the Pacific and Gulf ports of the corridor.

English Wikipedia, from the ministry's traffic tables, gives 1,145.4 km; Spanish Wikipedia gives 1,158 km, of which 96 km are in Sinaloa, 470 km in Durango, 311 km in Coahuila, 248 km in Nuevo León and 33 km in Tamaulipas. A tolled road, 40D, runs alongside for much of the way, including the Durango–Mazatlán motorway over the sierra.
zh: 40 号联邦公路自锡那罗亚海岸的比利亚乌尼翁爬上西马德雷山脉，经魔鬼脊翻山到杜兰戈城，再横越高原到戈麦斯帕拉西奥和托雷翁所在的拉古纳地区。由此穿过科阿韦拉沙漠到萨尔蒂约，下到蒙特雷，再经卡德雷塔沿平原通往格兰德河畔的雷诺萨。西班牙文维基百科称之为“跨洋公路”或“马萨特兰—马塔莫罗斯公路”，取名自这条走廊两头的太平洋港口和墨西哥湾港口。
英文维基百科依据交通部交通数据表，给出 1,145.4 公里；西班牙文维基百科作 1,158 公里，其中锡那罗亚州 96 公里，杜兰戈州 470 公里，科阿韦拉州 311 公里，新莱昂州 248 公里，塔毛利帕斯州 33 公里。收费路 40D 在大部分路段并行，其中包括翻越山脉的杜兰戈—马萨特兰高速。

en: A road from Durango to the Pacific was decreed by Antonio López de Santa Anna on 17 May 1843, and the engineers Aguado and Banda delivered a survey on 31 December 1869, but nothing was built for another sixty years. Work began in 1930; President Lázaro Cárdenas inspected the first 12 km on 20 February 1935. The work was then suspended and resumed in 1941.

The 281.52 km road between Durango and Mazatlán was finished in 1960 and inaugurated on 30 November 1960 at the Espinazo del Diablo, at kilometre 168, with the governor of Durango, Francisco González de la Vega. Spanish Wikipedia dates the completion of the whole highway to the same year, under President Adolfo López Mateos.
zh: 1843 年 5 月 17 日，安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德圣安纳颁令修建杜兰戈通往太平洋的道路；1869 年 12 月 31 日，工程师阿瓜多和班达交出了勘测成果，但此后六十年什么也没修。工程于 1930 年开工；1935 年 2 月 20 日，拉萨罗·卡德纳斯总统视察了最初的 12 公里。此后工程中断，1941 年复工。
杜兰戈至马萨特兰的 281.52 公里公路于 1960 年完工，1960 年 11 月 30 日在 168 公里处的魔鬼脊落成，杜兰戈州州长弗朗西斯科·冈萨雷斯·德拉维加出席。西班牙文维基百科将全线完工也定在同一年，即阿道弗·洛佩斯·马特奥斯总统任内。

en: The tolled 40D between Durango and Mazatlán, opened in 2013, crosses the same sierra on a far straighter line; the tunnelling association AMITOS gives the distance as cut from 305 km to 230 km. It has 61 tunnels totalling 19.3 km and 115 bridges and other structures. The Baluarte bridge is 1,124 m long and stands 402.6 m above the river; the El Sinaloense tunnel is about 2.8 km long. The journey fell from about six hours to two and a half.
zh: 2013 年通车的杜兰戈—马萨特兰收费路 40D 以笔直得多的线形翻越同一座山脉；据墨西哥隧道协会 AMITOS，路程由 305 公里缩短为 230 公里。沿线有 61 座隧道，总长 19.3 公里，另有 115 座桥梁和其他构筑物。巴卢阿尔特大桥长 1,124 米，桥面高出河谷 402.6 米；锡那罗亚人隧道长约 2.8 公里。行程由约六小时缩短为两个半小时。

en: No cost has been found for the original road. The Durango–Mazatlán motorway cost 28,600 million pesos by its opening in 2013, of which 18,600 million went on the last 67.6 km, opened on 17 October 2013 at Coscomate. The trade paper T21 reported that it took ten to twelve years and more than twice its initial budget. The federal development bank, Banobras, provided about 90 per cent of the financing. At the opening the toll for a car from Durango to Mazatlán was 506 pesos.
zh: 未找到原有公路的造价。杜兰戈—马萨特兰高速到 2013 年通车时耗资 286 亿比索，其中 186 亿用于最后的 67.6 公里；该段于 2013 年 10 月 17 日在科斯科马特通车。行业刊物 T21 报道，工程历时十到十二年，花费超过初始预算的两倍。联邦开发银行 Banobras 提供了约 90% 的融资。通车时，小汽车从杜兰戈到马萨特兰的通行费为 506 比索。

value.en: Sources differ: 1,145.4 km (English Wikipedia, from the ministry's traffic tables) or 1,158 km (Spanish Wikipedia)
value.zh: 各方不一：1,145.4 公里（英文维基百科，依据交通部交通数据表）或 1,158 公里（西班牙文维基百科）

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 40; Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 40

why.en: No cost was found for the free road, built in pieces between 1930 and 1960. The parallel toll road 40D over the sierra cost 28,600 million pesos (2013), given separately below.
why.zh: 免费路于 1930 至 1960 年间分段修建，未找到造价。翻越山脉的并行收费路 40D 耗资 286 亿比索（2013 年），另列于下。

value.en: Federal government for the free road; for the Durango–Mazatlán toll road, Banobras provided about 90 per cent of the financing
value.zh: 免费路由联邦政府出资；杜兰戈—马萨特兰收费路约 90% 的融资由 Banobras 提供

figures.source: Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 40; Expansión, on the Durango–Mazatlán motorway

value.en: 230 km; 28,600 million pesos in all, 18,600 million for the last 67.6 km; opened 17 October 2013; car toll 506 pesos (2013)
value.zh: 230 公里；总造价 286 亿比索，其中最后 67.6 公里 186 亿；2013 年 10 月 17 日通车；小汽车通行费 506 比索（2013 年）

figures.source: El Financiero and La Jornada, reports on the opening, October 2013; T21

value.en: 1,124 m long, 402.6 m above the river

figures.source: AMITOS (Asociación Mexicana de Ingeniería de Túneles y Obras Subterráneas), paper on the Durango–Mazatlán motorway

value.en: 61 tunnels, 19.3 km in total; the longest, El Sinaloense, about 2.8 km
value.zh: 61 座，总长 19.3 公里；最长的锡那罗亚人隧道约 2.8 公里

figures.source: AMITOS, paper on the Durango–Mazatlán motorway

timeline.en: Santa Anna decrees a road from Durango to the Pacific on 17 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 17 日，圣安纳颁令修建杜兰戈通往太平洋的道路。

timeline.en: The engineers Aguado and Banda deliver their survey on 31 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，工程师阿瓜多和班达交出勘测成果。

timeline.en: Construction of the Durango–Mazatlán road begins.
timeline.zh: 杜兰戈—马萨特兰公路开工。

timeline.en: President Cárdenas inspects the first 12 km on 20 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 20 日，卡德纳斯总统视察最初的 12 公里。

timeline.en: The Durango–Mazatlán road is inaugurated on 30 November at the Espinazo del Diablo.
timeline.zh: 11 月 30 日，杜兰戈—马萨特兰公路在魔鬼脊落成。

timeline.en: The Durango–Mazatlán motorway opens on 17 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 17 日，杜兰戈—马萨特兰高速通车。
